title: Mainnet tier line
description: One line of corpus/mainnet/tier.jsonl: one pubnet transaction, located in its public-lake object. Lines are in the cover's order; `tokens` are the token ids the transaction holds that no earlier line holds.

tx_index.description: Apply order: the index into the ledger's tx_processing.

lake_key.description: The object's key under the header's lake store.

blob_offset.description: Offset of the ledger's LedgerCloseMeta in the decompressed object.

parts.description: The transaction's parts as `scan cut-slices` cuts them: name, XDR type, JSON path in the ledger, byte offset in the LedgerCloseMeta, length, sha256.

rarity.description: Occurrences of the transaction's rarest token in the scan's token table (an upper bound on the transactions carrying it).
